headline: Body of missing Jordanian sailor found off UAE eight days after tanker attack
label: NEWS
caption:
Tragic news emerging from the region today. 🌊

According to The National, the body of a missing Jordanian sailor was found off the coast of the UAE eight days after a tanker attack.

Authorities recovered the remains following an extensive search operation in the area.

Further details regarding the incident and the condition of the vessel are awaited.

What more should be done to protect sailors in the region? 👇
